brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Full bases at 0,0,0 through 0,0,2 stacked vertically (pieces 0,0,0;full / 0,0,1;full / 0,0,2;full) forming 3 levels, backed/braced by half-n bases at 0,1,0-2; lockJoints and caps applied, meshClash clear
3 drawers: drawer:0#0,1#cut at level 0, drawer:1#0,1#cut at level 1, drawer:2#0,1#cut at level 2 – one per storey on south face using half bases with jointBolts

finish.summary: Built a 3-storey vertical cabinet (stacked full hex bases at 0,0,0-2) with adjoining half bases providing drawer fronts. Added 3 drawers, one per level, locked joints and capped open faces.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
